digest.component_or_area: code-review project extension / rebar criterion authoring
propositions: A project-owned code-review criterion must enforce phase-boundary contracts: Pass 1 discovers only, Pass 2 verifies only, Pass 3 decides deterministically, Pass 4 coaches non-prescriptively.
Pass 1 must emit grounded evidence with no severity/confidence/suggested_fix and must not assess validity, impact, policy, or remediation.
Pass 2 must answer only atomic validity and impact questions, never discover new findings or prescribe fixes.

The criterion's eval corpus must distinguish six must-fire cases (RP-F1..RP-F6 for validity leaks, policy leaks, remediation leaks, Pass-2 ownership, LLM discretion, and coaching boundary) and six must-not-fire cases (RP-N1..RP-N6 for refined discovery scope, strengthened evidence, atomic binary questions, deterministic thresholds, non-prescriptive coaching, and documentation/grandfathered debt).
Live calibration across three runs must achieve recall 1.0, false_accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, minimum per-case stability at least 2/3, and Cohen kappa at least 0.70.

The criterion must be activated in criteria_routing.json with exec 1-TURN, block_threshold 0.90, blocking_enabled false, and must be entirely project-owned (only .rebar assets, tests, docs, and gitignore modified).
